tavily.name: Tavily
tavily.description: Searches the web and extracts, maps, and crawls pages for research.
tavily.access: Needs a Tavily API key. Searches count against the Tavily account the key belongs to.
tavily.dataDestination: Searches and requested addresses are sent to mcp.tavily.com.

setup.advice: Sign in, then copy your API key from the dashboard.
